name: Trade Offer
look: A young man with long dark hair, a mustache and goatee, in a gray suit and tie, steeples his fingers in front of his chest and looks into the camera under purple LED lights. A red banner reads TRADE OFFER, with "i receive:" and "you receive:" below it.
use: Lays out a lopsided or absurd deal. Under "i receive" goes what the offerer wants, and under "you receive" goes the poor, funny or oddly generous thing offered in return.
slots: label on the man: who is proposing the trade
under 'i receive:' on the left: what he gets
under 'you receive:' on the right: what you get in return
describe: guy in a suit with fingers together making a deal
man with long hair and a mustache under a red warning banner
tiktok guy offering a deal with i receive and you receive
smug man in a suit steepling his fingers with purple lights
long haired dude proposing an unfair exchange
origin: From a TikTok video in which a long-haired man in a suit proposes trades, with on-screen labels for what each side receives.
